SELECTED_INDEX: 4
CONFIDENCE: 0.55
EXPLANATION: The spectrum is dominated by aliphatic C–H stretches at 2878/2932/2963 cm⁻¹ (consistent with multiple CH3/CH2 groups; cf. GFQ-003) and a CH2/CH3 deformation near 1453 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003). Two distinct C–O-related bands appear at 1044 and 1137 cm⁻¹, which strongly suggests the coexistence of an alcohol C–O stretch (≈1040–1060, primary/ether symmetric) and a higher-frequency C–O/C–O–C mode (≈1100–1140, tertiary alcohol or ether asymmetric). Candidate 4 (CCC(C)C1OCC1O) contains both a tertiary alcohol and a cyclic ether (oxetane), naturally producing two C–O features. The cluster at 825/872/957 cm⁻¹ is consistent with ring-breathing/deformation modes of a small cyclic ether, whereas candidates without ether rings struggle to account for these bands. The presence of a CH3-associated stretch near 2963 also fits the branched substituents in 4.
